name: meeple-as-card-v1
description: ⚠️ 09/09/2026, THE COMMONS FLIP: THIS ARM NOW PINS THE PASSENGERS AS WELL. Dean ruled the commons in as the engine DEFAULT (docs/commons-handoff-2026-09-09-v1.md), which moved four leaves at once - rules.turn.visitCurrency to 'commons', rules.turn.bonusTiming to 'start', rules.turn.startingMeeplesPerColour to 0, and the Orchard door's printed draw to 2/2. An overlay that pins only what it is named for stops being the arm it is called, silently, which is the 05/09/2026 lesson written down: NAME THE PASSENGERS BEFORE RULING AN ARM IN. So the `set` below carries every leaf this arm's game relied on, whether or not it was in the original experiment. ⭐ 05/09/2026: DEAN RULED R17 IN AND THE ENGINE DEFAULTS MOVED WITH IT. The shipped game is now meepleAsCard true, meepleAsCardGoesTo 'board', slotToll 1 and meepleCapPerColour 2, which is exactly overlays/meeple-on-board-v1.overlay.json. ⭐ SO THIS OVERLAY IS NOW THE CONTROL FOR R17, and it pins meepleAsCardGoesTo 'box' explicitly because 'board' is the default it is controlling for. It is the handoff v2 arm: the same rules with a resource spend LEAVING THE GAME rather than landing on a neighbour's board. It is also the regression test on a live code path - fx.ts payMeeplesAsCards is reached by nothing else at scale - and it is the honest answer to 'was R17 the thing that fixed it?': the pair reads hook 0.09 against 0.31 and a bonus-slot gap of +75.5 against +1.0 on identical seeds. THE ARM. The handoff-v2 design in full (Dean, 04/09/2026 evening, docs/meeple-loop-visit-handoff-2026-09-04-v2.md), read against the shipped v1 meeple loop (overlays/meeple-loop-v1.overlay.json is now a no-op naming the same default, so the real control here is the base game with none of these three knobs set). THE DIAGNOSIS IT IS BUILT ON. v1 measured 0.13 short of the hook floor and starving in the back half - 13.4 meeples a game boxed by the cap, rival visits falling from 95k before midgame to 73k after - and Dean's reading was that a meeple with no competing use is a coupon, not a cost: spending it is not a decision. The Feld lens agrees, a currency that does nothing else reads as bookkeeping. The fix is to give the meeple a second use in cards, and to price the blocked slot instead of refusing it outright. WHAT THE ARM CHANGES, ALL AT ONCE, so a null result is informative and a positive one is not attributable to a single lever. R15 (meepleAsCard true): a meeple of a colour may pay wherever a card of that colour would - build costs including the n-of-suit requirements and the 2-own-suit Power/Endgame cost, a Grow's activation payment, a delivery crate - and a meeple spent this way goes straight to the box, never a hand, a barn or a stack, and never counts toward the hand limit. Two meeples still pay as one card of any colour, R10's wild pair reused rather than re-rated. A meeple paid into a Grow does not join the stack or count toward the threshold, so it can activate a building already at capacity - a priced clog bypass, deliberate. R4 amended (meepleCapPerColour 2): the supply cap doubles, a processing bound rather than a design rule in Dean's own words - 'let's see if this is actually a problem before we try to fix it' - so the boxed-by-cap count must be tracked and reported by source, not assumed away. R6 amended (slotToll 1): a slot is never blocked any more, only priced. Visiting a slot already holding k meeples costs k extra meeples of any colours on top of the acting one, and the toll is boxed, not handed to the host - nothing is ever refused. READ IN THIS ORDER, per section 3 of the handoff, and read the noise floor before any of them. (1) THE HOOK, rival visits per player per turn against 0.5, then the bonus mix four ways. (2) ACTIONS PER TURN against the 1.5 target set 04/09/2026 evening (main plus bought doors; Collect draws on their own line), with game length beside it. (3) MEEPLES SPENT AS RESOURCES, per game and by use - build / activation / delivery - with activations of an at-threshold building paid by a meeple counted apart, and as a share of all meeple exits: this is the new dial and the number that says whether the two uses compete or one dominates. (4) MEEPLES BOXED BY SOURCE: collect cap, island cap, resource by use, toll. (5) THE POOL BY ROUND - a pool that empties by midgame is the coin drought again. (6) THE HOARD-AND-DUMP LINE: median supply in the last third, and the share of resource spends in the final two rounds. (7) TOLL VISITS: share of visits paying a toll, mean toll paid, and whether the popular farm changes hands. (8) DELIVERIES PER PLAYER AND THE BARN GLUT, since meeples now pay crates. (9) WORST-CASE LEGAL MOVES AND SECONDS PER 2-SEAT GAME against the v1 arm - stop if either has moved by more than 2x, because meeples now enter the payment enumerator and must be handled as counts of interchangeable tokens per colour, never as individual cards in the subset enumeration, or this is the 12-card hand-limit blowup again with meeples standing in for the extra cards. ⚠️ CORRECTED 05/09/2026, and the sentence that follows was true only on 04/09/2026: the engine reads every one of these knobs now, and this arm is a real result. THE ORIGINAL WARNING, kept so a report dated 04/09 can still be read against it: at that stage of the build the engine did not yet read meepleAsCard or slotToll at all, so running this overlay currently behaves exactly like the shipped v1 loop under meepleCapPerColour 2 - that is expected and is not a result. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⚠️ 13/09/2026: rules.turn.selfVisitAllowed true and rules.economy.noticeBoardsBySeats.2 1 are pinned here because the shipped defaults flipped when the commons was deleted, so this arm stays the game it was. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace were removed with the delivery spaces. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name; under visitCurrency 'meeple' its island meeples now sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level.
